module.purpose: Provides the client-side settings layout, navigation structure, permission-aware menu filtering, team navigation, and responsive sidebar behavior for the web application.
module.summary: This client component assembles the settings experience around the shared Shell layout. It defines navigation tabs for account, security, billing, developer, organization, team, and administration areas, then filters or augments them using authentication state, organization branding, roles, permissions, feature flags, deployment constants, and user security configuration. It also renders responsive desktop and mobile navigation, collapsible team menus, organization-specific links, external destinations, loading states, and an error boundary around settings content.
module.businessContext: This supports account, organization, team, billing, security, and administration workflows in the scheduling platform. If it fails, users may lose access to settings pages or see unauthorized navigation.

assumptions.description: The caller supplies children and may supply teamFeatures, permissions, and Shell properties.
WEBAPP_URL, HOSTED_CAL_FEATURES, and IS_CALCOM provide correctly configured deployment values.
Team records provide id, name, parentId, accepted, role, logoUrl, and organization-admin fields.
Session user data may provide role, organization id, and identity-provider security fields.
Menu open states are initialized from the URL id query parameter after team data becomes available.
The component runs as a client component with access to window, document, and browser event APIs.
